parsed.reason: This message hits all five criteria perfectly. It offers to put things in their real calendar by email ("I can send calendar invites to your email"), and asks them to TEXT their address back ("text me your address"). The language is quiet and plain first person with no greeting or parent's name. There's no pressure, urgency, deadline, or explanation of why it helps Hale. The instruction to text the address back (not go anywhere) is clear and appropriate.
